name: boundaryxp
description: Analyze evidence-backed 7+1 task boundaries with the host LLM and verify submitted operands using BoundaryXP's compiled native Core. Windows and Linux x64; platform-specific pinned packages.

interface.longDescription: Use the current host LLM to interpret parent/child tasks, then independently verify supported finite operands with the native Core. Includes 21 MCP tools, 17 resources, custom L2/L3 dictionaries and a local browser workbench. Requires Windows x64 or Linux x64/glibc >=2.36 and Node >=22.19/npm. Downloads the platform-specific pinned compiled npm package on first use into separate plugin-owned storage; no model API key in host mode. Original Core source is not included.
defaultPrompt: Use BoundaryXP MCP to read bx_capabilities in English, list profiles and open its workbench. Do not submit analysis or change existing data.
通过 BoundaryXP MCP 查看中文工具帮助与 L2/L3 字典格式，打开工作台，暂不提交分析。
